notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Two searches and a few reads found only the statewide tnlandforms list (Obion County, 525 ft, removed). Searches returned a Scawley Creek topo listing in Obion County, which is a stream, not a lookout, so it was not used. Nothing found gives a build date, builder, staffing, fires, or what remains today. The NRHP study covers the state network; no source found ties Scawley to it, so the story keeps that context statewide. Record has no registers; no listing found on the cached NHLR Tennessee list or the FFLOS Tennessee list (four former sites, none Scawley). Record elevation_m 160.0 matches 525 ft. Record status gone matches removed. Consider whether a fuller search (county histories, Obion County newspapers) is worth a later pass.
